lines.text: Who studies with you every night?

data.define: A friendly word for a friend.

misuse.text: Don't say 'buddy' to an angry stranger.

data.l1_hook: Siapa yang belajar bersamamu setiap malam? "buddy".

native.caption:
Apa arti “buddy”?
“buddy” = teman.
Contoh: “He's my study buddy.” (Dia itu teman belajar ("buddy") aku.)
